answer: Make earning require a live checkpoint chain. Every few hours the server issues each identity a short-lived token derived from its last checkpoint; the agent must post its next claim on the public trellis before that token expires, or the chain breaks and the epoch pays nothing. An honest agent keeps one chain alive with brief pings. A sybil operator crossing the tundra with a thousand clones must feed a thousand separate chains in parallel, in real time, with no backfilling a missed link — reaching the summit pays only those who stayed present the whole climb.
